title: The automatic pass is latched per state counter, which the owner ruling of 2026-08-29 (“THE CLIENT MAY NOT HOLD A…”)(b) rules out
summary: The owner ruling of 2026-08-29 (“THE CLIENT MAY NOT HOLD A…”)(b) rules that an automatic answer (it names the haste-step ready and the automatic pass) is latched by being unanswered, never by a state counter, because states keep arriving while an intent is outstanding. The owner ruling of 2026-08-29 (“the affordances that must stay live…”) says the automatic pass is latched once per actionCount via takeAutoPass, and test 70 [59] asserts that a new state number re-opens the latch. If a state with a new actionCount reaches a seat while its automatic pass is still outstanding, a second pass could go out and come back refused. The verifier confirmed it in the client: the haste ready was converted (hasteAutoOut), but the automatic pass still goes through takeAutoPass, keyed on actionCount.

title: Inside a hidden step a rewind cut may take back the other seat's done-planning flag
summary: rewindPlans' ownOnly refuses a cut inside an open hidden step only for the other seat's items marked hidden; donePlanning/doneDeploying/amend are never marked hidden (PUBLIC_IN_HIDDEN), so a cut that takes back the other seat's 'done planning' is offered (probe zz-probe-U23-2b). The code comment says a cut inside the step is offered only where it takes back nothing but the asking seat's own actions. Either the comment/rule should say 'nothing the other seat did unseen', or the cut should be refused. Not a leak (the flag is public), but it does undo the other player's action without it being the step start.

evidence.quote: const PUBLIC_IN_HIDDEN = new Set(['donePlanning', 'doneDeploying', 'amend']);
for (let i = to; i < len; i++) if (it(i).hidden && it(i).seat !== seat) return false;

title: 'Back to the start of the step before' can cut just before a forced action and land at the start of the current step
summary: rewindPlans offers 'prev' at startOf(here - 1) without the forced-action check the 'before' cuts get. When the step before began with a forced action (seed 48593: an empty declareBlocks at index 43, step 'battle (blocks, counterattack)'), the cut lands before it, the rebuilt board owes the forced step, and main.ts's drain re-takes it (log back to 44). So the option does not reach the step before, and 485 §4's guarantee 'never a cut at a forced step' fails for this option. The real() check counts items from the cut to the end, which include the current step's actions, so it does not drop a step that was nothing but a forced action, though the 485 §4 CT-340 comment says such a step should not be offered. Shown by client/server/test/zz-probe-U23-1.test.ts 'zz-U23-4'.
